On all nonnegative states N>0, if h≤1/max{β+ψv+μ, μ+φ, μ+γ+φ1+β, μ+κ+ωv, μ+ω, μ}, each Euler coordinate remains nonnegative and S_{n+1}≥hΛ>0; hence geometric H bound holds for every β>0 and every nonnegative initial state. Exact rational arithmetic of frozen verifier confirms at Λ=5,β=20, all other positive rates=1, true endemic state (15/11,15/11,5/11,5/11,5/22,15/22), incidence 30/11, N=50/11; true DFE infected eigenvalues 1,-6 versus printed trace -17 determinant 18, h=1/40 gives H≤(39/40)^nH0. This is a property of the printed zero-noise recurrence, not stochastic almost-sure extinction or actual source implementation.
